goal: Iske baad aap for loop se shape ko hila sakenge: draw, wait, clear, move, repeat, aur speed, direction aur step size badal sakenge.
warmup: School ki copy mein flip-book cartoon: har page par drawing zara si mukhtalif hoti hai, aur jab aap pages tez tez palatte hain to aankh ko harkat nazar aati hai. Computer par animation bilkul yehi hai: picture draw karo, thori der ruko, use mita do, zara hila kar dobara draw karo, aur dohrate jao.
definition: Animation ka matlab hai bohat si pictures (frames) ek ke baad ek dikhana, jin mein shape thori nayi position par hoti hai. graphics.h mein recipe yeh hai: draw, delay, cleardevice, move, repeat. For loop is ke liye behtareen hai, kyunke loop variable (masalan x) hi position HAI aur har pass par chhote step se badalta hai. graphics.h standard C++ nahi hai. Yeh sirf lab PC par Turbo C++ (DOSBox) ya Code::Blocks/Dev-C++ ke saath WinBGIm library mein chalta hai, is liye page ka in-page compiler in programs ko nahi chala sakta. Is page ka canvas ek simulation hai jo woh draw karta hai jo wohi calls draw karti. Page par canvas loop ke frames chala kar dikhata hai taake aap harkat dekh saken.
howItWorks: Loop for (int x = 50; x <= 550; x += 5) dekhein. x 50 se shuru hota hai, har dafa 5 se barhta hai, aur 550 ke baad ruk jata hai, to (550 - 50) / 5 + 1 = 101 frames hote hain. Har pass mein: cleardevice() purani picture saaf karta hai, setcolor aur circle(x, 240, 30) nayi x par nayi picture draw karte hain, aur delay(30) 30 milliseconds rukta hai, is liye poora run taqriban 101 x 30 ms = 3 seconds leta hai. Speed ke do knobs hain: step size (bara step har frame mein door tak jump karta hai, to tez magar kam smooth chalta hai) aur delay (chhota delay matlab har second zyada frames, to tez chalta hai). Direction loop se aati hai: x barhe to right ki taraf, y barhe to screen par NEECHE (yaad rakhein y neeche ki taraf barhta hai). Kai hisson ko saath hilane ke liye har ek ko x plus ek fixed offset par draw karein, jaise neeche wali car. Bouncing, alfaaz mein: right ki taraf hilao jab tak deewar na aa jaye, phir ginti ulti karo taake shape left ki taraf chale, aur dohrao. Asal BGI par picture flicker kar sakti hai kyunke cleardevice har redraw se pehle poori screen khali kar deta hai; programs isse double buffering se bachte hain (chhupe page par draw karo aur tayyar hone par dikhao), jo is course se aage ki baat hai.
